title: Leadership & Management
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Un buen líder no solo sabe qué hacer, sino cómo comunicarlo. Con estas palabras podrás gestionar equipos, alinear inversores (stakeholders) y delegar efectivamente.

parts.visual:
Liderazgo de Equipos: 
- Delegate (Delegar tareas). 
Ej: A good manager knows how to delegate. 
- Micromanage (Microgestionar / Controlar cada pequeño detalle, usualmente negativo). 
Ej: Employees hate it when their boss micromanages them. 
- Empower (Empoderar / Dar autoridad o poder a alguien). 
Ej: We need to empower our employees to make decisions.
parts.audio: Team Leadership. 'Delegate' means to give tasks or responsibilities to others. For example: A good manager knows how to delegate. 'Micromanage' is to control every small detail of someone's work. It usually has a negative meaning. For example: Employees hate it when their boss micromanages them. 'Empower' means to give someone the authority or power to do something. For example: We need to empower our employees to make decisions.

parts.visual:
Estrategia y Medición: 
- Stakeholder (Parte interesada / Cualquiera afectado por las acciones de la empresa: empleados, clientes, inversores). 
Ej: We must consider the needs of all stakeholders. 
- Benchmark (Punto de referencia / Estándar para comparar). 
Ej: Her performance is the benchmark for the rest of the team. 
- Synergize / Synergy (Sinergia / Trabajar juntos para un mejor resultado). 
Ej: The two departments need to synergize to increase efficiency.
parts.audio: Strategy and Measurement. A 'Stakeholder' is anyone who is affected by the actions of a company, such as employees, customers, or investors. For example: We must consider the needs of all stakeholders. A 'Benchmark' is a standard or point of reference against which things may be compared. For example: Her performance is the benchmark for the rest of the team. 'Synergy' is when two or more things work together to produce a better result. For example: The two departments need to synergize to increase efficiency.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término de liderazgo o gestión corporativa correcto.

questions.question: You can't do everything yourself. You need to ____ some tasks to your team. (Delegar).
My boss wants to approve every single email I send. He likes to ____. (Microgestionar).
We must ensure that all our ____, including investors and employees, are happy. (Partes interesadas).
questions.explanation: Stakeholders = cualquier persona o grupo afectado por la empresa. (Shareholders son solo los accionistas).

questions.question: Apple's customer service is often used as a ____ for other tech companies. (Punto de referencia / Estándar).
questions.explanation: Benchmark = punto de referencia para medir calidad o rendimiento.

questions.question: To improve motivation, we must ____ our team to make their own decisions. (Empoderar / Dar autoridad).
By merging the two departments, we hope to create a powerful ____. (Sinergia).
As a leader, you must be ____ and take responsibility for your actions. (Responsable de tus actos / Que rinde cuentas).
questions.explanation: Accountable = responsable, que debe rendir cuentas.

questions.question: We need to ____ the process to make it faster and cheaper. (Agilizar / Optimizar).
questions.explanation: Streamline = optimizar, simplificar o hacer más eficiente un proceso.

questions.question: The HR department is responsible for the ____ of new employees. (Contratación).
During their first week, new hires go through an ____ process. (Proceso de integración/orientación).
questions.explanation: Onboarding = inducción o integración de un nuevo empleado.

questions.question: The company suffers from a high staff ____. People quit every month. (Rotación de personal).
questions.explanation: Staff turnover = rotación de personal (tasa a la que los empleados dejan la empresa).

questions.question: We will conduct a performance ____ at the end of the year. (Evaluación de desempeño).
She is taking a ____ leave for six months after having her baby. (Baja por maternidad).
We need to identify the ____ in our production line that is causing the delay. (Cuello de botella).
questions.explanation: Bottleneck = cuello de botella (punto de congestión en un proceso).

questions.question: Let's ____ some ideas for the new marketing campaign. (Hacer lluvia de ideas).
It is important to align our daily tasks with the company's ____ goals. (Objetivos a largo plazo).
We need someone to ____ this project and make sure it finishes on time. (Supervisar).
A CEO must have a clear ____ for the future of the company. (Visión).
Our main ____ is to provide affordable healthcare to everyone. (Misión).
questions.explanation: Mission = misión (el propósito actual de la empresa).

questions.question: We need to ____ the impact of the new regulations on our business. (Evaluar).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el término de management correcto.

questions.question: You must ____ tasks. (Delegar con D)
Don't ____ me! (Microgestionar con M)
All the ____. (Partes interesadas con S)
This is the ____. (Punto de referencia con B)
Create ____. (Sinergia con S)
Be ____. (Responsable/Rendir cuentas con A)
____ the process. (Agilizar/Optimizar con S)
The ____ process. (Integración de nuevos empleados con O)
High staff ____. (Rotación de personal con T)
Identify the ____. (Cuello de botella con B)
